findings.evidenceJa: 午前二時を回っていた
findings.governingReading: 午前二時を回っていた places the clock beyond two rather than on the hourly strike.
findings.explanation: Past two o’clock becomes the clock striking exactly two.

findings.highlight: Not once did I give into temptation and open them until my work was done.
findings.evidenceJa: 目隠しなら誘惑に負けて目蓋を開けることもない
findings.governingReading: 目隠しなら誘惑に負けて目蓋を開けることもない describes a counterfactual benefit of the blindfold he lacked.
findings.explanation: A blindfold would stop him opening his eyes becomes a claim he never opened them.

findings.evidenceJa: ぬちゃりと音をたてている
findings.governingReading: ぬちゃりと音をたてている names the wet sound of everything touched, with no warmth modifier.
findings.explanation: A squelching contact sound gains warmth.

findings.highlight: walking at a particular brisk pace.
findings.evidenceJa: ものすごい大股で歩いている
findings.governingReading: ものすごい大股 denies an enormous stride length as the reason a walker outruns him.
findings.explanation: Not taking huge strides becomes not walking briskly.

findings.highlight: enough to breath a little heavily
findings.evidenceJa: 少し息が弾むくらいに走っている
findings.governingReading: The English infinitive construction requires the verb breathe rather than the noun breath.
findings.explanation: Breath is used as a verb instead of breathe.

findings.highlight: so perfect for each other they might as well be twins
findings.evidenceJa: 双子のようにうり二つ
findings.governingReading: うり二つ denotes extreme visual likeness, which makes the beautiful sisters appear like twins in this vision.
findings.explanation: Two figures looking identical becomes two figures being perfect for each other.

findings.highlight: nor do I feel any guilt.
findings.governingReading: 嫌悪感 is aversion/disgust as he views the apparent embrace.

findings.highlight: It giddily drains its prey of life.
findings.evidenceJa: ふらふらと吸い寄せられる
findings.governingReading: ふらふらと吸い寄せられる is passive attraction, continuing the narrator’s movement into the classroom before his attempt to rescue Mitsuzuri.
findings.explanation: Being unsteadily drawn toward the scene becomes the predator draining its prey.

findings.highlight: She exposes Mitsuzuri's defenseless, pale throat.
findings.evidenceJa: 無抵抗の美綴が、白い喉を遠坂の前に晒していた
findings.governingReading: 無抵抗の美綴が ... 晒していた makes the unresisting victim the subject of the throat presentation.
findings.explanation: Mitsuzuri’s nonresisting exposed throat becomes the predator actively exposing it.

findings.highlight: The wet sound tickles my ears.
findings.governingReading: 滴る continues the sticky liquid sensation dominating the dream.
findings.explanation: Wet sound dripping into his ear becomes tickling his ear.

findings.governingReading: The intended English adverb is irresistibly.

findings.highlight: nipping the side of my neck.
findings.governingReading: 唇が触れている and 首筋に横から specify lip contact; page37 then separately introduces skin-piercing fangs and biting.
findings.explanation: Lips contacting the side of the neck becomes nipping before the later fang penetration.

findings.highlight: It seeps into my bones, muscles, and skin.
findings.evidenceJa: 骨を、筋肉を、皮膚を柔らかくふやかしていく
findings.governingReading: 柔らかくふやかしていく, 溶かされて, and 骨が抜かれていた continue bodily dissolution beyond general fluid entry.
findings.explanation: Softening tissue, melting below the neck, and removing bones are weakened to seepage, flow, and limpness.

findings.highlight: It floods my throat, and I can't even moan.
findings.evidenceJa: 喉はもう溶けて、呻きしか漏れない
findings.governingReading: 呻きしか漏れない excludes every sound except moaning; his throat has already melted.
findings.explanation: Only moans escaping his melted throat becomes inability even to moan.

findings.highlight: I hear a voice that doesn't belong.
findings.evidenceJa: 聞こえるはずのない声が聞こえる
findings.governingReading: 食いついたままで、聞こえるはずのない声 ties the impossibility to a mouth still biting him.
findings.explanation: An impossible audible voice becomes a voice that does not belong.

findings.governingReading: The intended word is desiccated in the drying/withered ending.
